QuestInfo.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Cleaning Tips 3
QuestInfo.0: Mrs. Ming Ming has 30 years in managing a household. She has agreed to teach you something about what she knows. Go see Mrs. Ming Ming.
QuestInfo.1: Mrs. Ming Ming believed that even useless Rubble from Golems could become the most helpful household tools depending on how they were used. She said she'd show Alpha and Beta how if they prepared the materials.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta learned from Mrs. Ming Ming how to use Golem rubble to make a natural furnace.

0.0: Lastly, I will teach you the final trick with Golem bits. We need more materials this time as well. I know you can take care of it without a problem. Not your first time, right?

yes.0: The material this time is #r#t4000966##k. If you prepare #r#t4000966##k #rx 10#k, I will teach you the big one.

no.0: You need to thank me. Knowledge like this can't be bought with money.

1.0: Did you bring all the required materials?

yes.0: I believe nobody knows about this except me. I also discovered this by accident. Look closely. If you place a #r#t4000966##k in a fireplace like this, then... Ta-da! The fire doesn't spread or die with the #r#t4000966##k in it. Safe AND practical.
yes.1: What do you think? It's all in how you use the stuff right? Something that seems useless can be useful right? If I have any more useful information I will let you know.

default.0: If you bring me #r#t4000966# x 10#k, I'll unlock the ultimate housekeeping secret for you.
